description: Certificate canonicalization vectors for the root signature (security.md 11.1). 'cert' is the certificate object as authored; 'canonical' is the exact UTF-8 byte string that must be produced after removing 'sig' and applying the restricted-JCS profile (security.md 11.1). A conforming canonicalizer must emit 'canonical' byte-for-byte. Control-character escaping is additionally covered by an in-code vector in canon_test.go, since raw control characters cannot appear in JSON source.
